# A415 Baroque anchor

A historical Baroque pitch anchor: 12-EDO degree 69 = 415 Hz. The same lattice as A440, but a different anchor (Principle 11).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/pitchAnchorA415>
